title: Lyra Direct SARS-CoV Assay Sample Preparation
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates certain steps of the [Lyra Direct SARS-CoV Assay](https://www.quidel.com/molecular-diagnostics/lyra-direct-sars-cov-2-assay). These steps include the addition of process buffer to the deep well block, mixing of the deep well block, and transferring samples to the PCR plate. --- * [P20 multi-channel GEN2 electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette?variant=5978988707869) * [P300 multi-channel GEN2 electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette?variant=5984202489885) * [Opentrons 20ul filter tiprack](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-filter-tip) * [Opentrons 200ul filter tiprack](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-1000ul-filter-tips) * [MicroAmp™ EnduraPlate™ Optical 96-Well PCR Plates](https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/4483354#/4483354) * [Eppendorf 96 Deep Well Block 1000ul](https://online-shop.eppendorf.us/US-en/Laboratory-Consumables-44512/Plates-44516/Eppendorf-Deepwell-Plates-PF-55960.html) * [Opentrons 10 Tube Rack with Falcon 4x50 mL, 6x15 mL Conical](https://shop.opentrons.com/products/tube-rack-set-1?_ga=2.93128221.1266032643.1606143320-1181961818.1604785212) * [NEST 12 Well Reservoir 15 mL](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/reservoirs/products/nest-12-well-reservoir-15-ml) --- **Single Channel Setup:** * Pipettes: P1000 Single GEN2 AND P20 Single GEN2 * Opentrons 1000ul filter/standard tipracks * Opentrons 20ul filter/standard tipracks * Opentrons 10 Tube Rack with Falcon 4x50 mL, 6x15 mL Conical (Slot 1, Process Buffer in A1) * Eppendorf 96 Deep Well Block 1000ul (Slot 2) * MicroAmp™ EnduraPlate™ Optical 96-Well PCR Plate (Slot 3, should be rested on top of the Eppendorf cooling block) **Multi Channel Setup:** * Pipettes: P300 Multi GEN2 AND P20 Multi GEN2 * Opentrons 200ul/300ul filter/standard tiprack * Ope
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather hardware and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: P20 multi‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette, P300 multi‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette, Opentrons 20 µL filter tiprack, Opentrons 200 µL filter tiprack, MicroAmp™ EnduraPlate™ Optical 96‑Well PCR plates, Eppendorf 96 Deep Well Block (1000 µL capacity), Opentrons 10‑tube rack with Falcon 4 × 50 mL and 6 × 15 mL conical tubes, and a NEST 12‑well reservoir (15 mL). Also have the single‑channel equivalents (P1000 Single GEN2, P20 Single GEN2) and their 1000 µL and 20 µL filter/standard tipracks available if using single‑channel mode.

steps.title: Configure sample and pipette settings
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, input the total number of samples (including controls). For example, 38 patient samples plus 2 controls = 40 total. Select the pipette configuration (either Single‑Channel or Multi‑Channel), then choose the left‑hand pipette type, the right‑hand pipette type, and the tip type to be used.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the Lyra Direct SARS‑CoV assay sample‑preparation protocol file into the Opentrons app.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the deck according to the provided deck map: place the Opentrons 10‑tube rack (Slot 1) with the Process Buffer in well A1, the Eppendorf 96 Deep Well Block (Slot 2), and the MicroAmp™ EnduraPlate™ PCR plate (Slot 3) resting on the Eppendorf cooling block. Load the appropriate tipracks (20 µL and 200 µL filter tipracks) into the remaining slots as indicated by the deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons app, run the calibration routine for each piece of labware and each pipette (P20 and P300 multi‑channel or the single‑channel equivalents). Follow the on‑screen prompts and use calibration tips as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Execute automated protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons app. The robot will automatically add Process Buffer to the deep‑well block, mix the deep‑well block, and transfer the samples from the deep‑well block to the PCR plate according to the Lyra Direct SARS‑CoV assay workflow.

steps.title: Confirm run completion
steps.instruction: After the robot finishes, verify that the protocol has completed without errors and that the PCR plate contains the transferred samples ready for downstream processing.
